policy: A record in this registry is not proof that its files are locally downloaded or parsed. Local validation state is tracked separately.

datasets.name: Mavrovouniotis E-CVRP benchmark (current upstream listing)
datasets.version: GitHub master snapshot; pin commit before experiments
datasets.recommended_use_cases: classical E-CVRP; load-dependent energy; charging-station density; scaling and metaheuristic comparison
datasets.licence_status: upstream repository terms must be checked before redistribution
datasets.notes: The uploaded 17-file ZIP is a separate historical/local snapshot; do not label it as the current 24-instance upstream listing. Current upstream file list has 24 .evrp instances.

datasets.name: Schneider-Goeke E-VRPTW instances
datasets.recommended_use_cases: time windows; clustered/random/random-clustered customer distributions; EVRP baselines and charging policy experiments
datasets.notes: The supplied archive contains 92 TXT instance files. Preserve the non-commercial restriction and cite both the dataset DOI and the 2014 paper.

datasets.name: Montoya et al. nonlinear charging benchmark
datasets.recommended_use_cases: nonlinear charging; partial recharge; comparison of charging models; charging-decision heuristics
datasets.licence_status: VRP-REP public listing; instance-level redistribution terms require source check
datasets.notes: Official VRP-REP catalogue lists 120 instances. DIMACS identifies this as the E-VRP-NL base set. Retrieve exact files from VRP-REP/DIMACS source and validate.

datasets.name: Froger capacitated charging-station variants
key_parameters: charger capacity at each station (1 or 2 chargers)
datasets.recommended_use_cases: station congestion; charger-capacity constraints; nonlinear charging; solution checker evaluation
datasets.notes: These 240 are two derived capacity variants per each of the 120 Montoya instances; they are not 240 unrelated base instances. DIMACS reports 120 base + 240 derived = 360 total across both categories.

datasets.name: Goeke-Schneider mixed-fleet EVRPTW-MF
key_parameters: EV and conventional vehicle fleet types
datasets.recommended_use_cases: mixed powertrain fleet; fleet allocation; real-world energy model; mixed-fleet routing
datasets.notes: Mendeley record does not state a total instance count in the surfaced metadata; do not invent one.

datasets.name: Felipe et al. GVRP multiple technologies and partial recharges
datasets.recommended_use_cases: partial recharge; charger technology choice; mixed charging infrastructure
datasets.licence_status: VRP-REP public listing; source terms to be checked
datasets.notes: VRP-REP currently catalogues 41 instances; some review literature describes a 60-instance FORT collection. Treat the discrepancy as unresolved until the precise release/archive is reconciled; do not combine counts.

datasets.name: Akbay et al. expanded two-echelon EVRP dataset
datasets.recommended_use_cases: two-echelon logistics; satellites; time windows; simultaneous pickup/delivery; partial deliveries; scale tests
datasets.licence_status: Zenodo record describes software/data release; verify archive-level licence before republishing
datasets.notes: Zenodo v2 states 3,000 instances. It is a distinct two-echelon family, not a single-echelon EVRP corpus.

datasets.name: V2G and dynamic energy pricing extended EVRPTW
datasets.recommended_use_cases: energy-cost optimization; V2G revenue; time-dependent charging; grid interaction
datasets.notes: Mendeley data record is available; inspect files and any linked paper before promoting compatibility to direct_fit.

datasets.name: Gradient-aware EVRPTW with altitude information
datasets.recommended_use_cases: grade-aware energy use; downhill regeneration; realistic energy modelling
datasets.notes: Dataset record explicitly describes modified Schneider instances; preserve parent-child derivation and inspect Description.docx for exact parameter units.

datasets.name: Charging-station energy differences
key_parameters: station-specific energy differences/attributes (exact fields in README)
datasets.recommended_use_cases: heterogeneous charging station energy characteristics; station-choice sensitivity
datasets.notes: Mendeley record describes three distinct data sets/configurations, not necessarily three individual problem instances. Inspect readme.txt before formal parameter mapping.

datasets.name: EVRP with backhauls and time windows under uncertainty (EVRPBTW-USUT)
datasets.recommended_use_cases: robust/stochastic routing; backhaul operations; deterministic-vs-robust methods; real-case validation
datasets.licence_status: Dryad dataset terms to be checked
datasets.notes: The GitHub README describes 60 synthetic instances (25/50/100 customers) plus a 47-customer real case. Counts should be rechecked against archive manifest before validation.

datasets.name: Mixed-fleet VRP with low-emission zones (EVRPTW-derived + Milan case)
datasets.recommended_use_cases: urban fleet transition; low-emission zones; mixed fleet; real road-distance case studies
datasets.notes: This is a derived dataset: cite both the dataset DOI and its paper, and explicitly acknowledge Schneider et al. as the parent benchmark.

datasets.name: Electric autonomous dial-a-ride benchmark (adjacent family)
datasets.recommended_use_cases: on-demand mobility; passenger routing; ride-pooling; battery-constrained DARP
datasets.licence_status: repository licence/file terms should be checked
datasets.notes: Adjacent electric mobility benchmark, not a freight EVRP dataset. Include in a separate problem-family collection.

datasets.name: Electric vehicle-drone routing instances (adjacent family)
datasets.notes: 128 instances adapted from Schneider et al. Cite Mara et al. (2023) for EVDRP and Schneider et al. (2014) as the parent benchmark source. Separate adjacent problem family, not standard EVRP.

datasets.name: EM-DARP electric shuttle demand-responsive routing dataset (adjacent family)
key_parameters: electric shuttle routing parameters (inspect release metadata)

compatibility.EM-DARP: candidate_direct (dataset files and associated paper need inspection)

datasets.licence_status: verify exact Zenodo record licence before redistribution
datasets.notes: New adjacent dataset published 19 October 2026. It is a DARP/mobility dataset, not a conventional freight EVRP benchmark; retain as a separate family.

local_snapshots.relationship: historical/uploaded snapshot; not the current 24-file upstream listing
